__doc__: v7.1 M3 — long-running process recovery template. Copy to .vela/guidelines/live-processes.json in your project and edit. If the file is absent, verify Phase 0 is skipped. Add one entry per long-running service the verifier should ensure is healthy before unit tests run. The verifier kills+restarts + waits for readyPath on each entry before proceeding to Phase 1.
